title: Sealed Bids at Midnight
summary: Rust Ootle auction template and headless CLI with signer-bound sealed bids, equal bonds, timed reveals and separate claims. November 12 review: Veil returned a committed mainnet template publication at 08:01:23 UTC and a committed settlement at 11:02:28 UTC, network byte 0, matching the creator’s published template and auction component. The settlement event reports a winning bid of 20 and one locked ghost bond. Unrevealed bids and bids below reserve permanently forfeit bonds. Revealed amounts and bidder keys are public. The README also documents a republished Esmeralda deployment and pins tari_template_lib 0.40. The new recording is a mainnet documentation walkthrough, not an auction performed here. The October testnet recording and failed component lookup remain in maintenance history.
